description: End-to-end workflow for requesting, validating, provisioning, monitoring, and managing connectivity services on a cloud exchange platform, including error handling, modification, and rollback.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer or tenant within the cloud exchange platform

project_id.description: Identifier for a logical project or account context under a customer

connection_request_id.description: Identifier for a requested connectivity order prior to activation

connection_id.description: Identifier for an active or provisioned connectivity service on the cloud exchange

provider_id.description: Identifier for a cloud or network service provider on the exchange

port_id.description: Identifier for a physical or logical port on the exchange

quote_id.description: Identifier for a commercial quote associated with a connection request

change_request_id.description: Identifier for a requested change to an existing connection

task_id.description: Identifier for a provisioning or workflow task running in the background

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: discover_exchange_capabilities
functions.description: List available providers, locations, and service profiles on the cloud exchange for a given customer and project context.

filters.description: Optional filters to narrow down the available capabilities

include.description: Additional data to include in the response

functions.returns: List of available providers, locations, ports, and service profiles for the specified customer and optional filters.

functions.name: check_connectivity_feasibility
functions.description: Perform a technical and policy feasibility check for a prospective connection between a customer port and target provider endpoint.

source.description: Source side details of the connection

redundancy_group.description: Optional redundancy group identifier if part of HA design

destination.description: Destination side details (provider or remote port)

service_profile_id.description: Identifier of target service profile offered by the provider

constraints.description: Optional constraints for latency, path diversity, and maintenance windows

maintenance_window.description: Preferred maintenance window for provisioning changes

functions.returns: Feasibility assessment including pass/fail, reasons, suggested adjustments, and an optional precheck reference ID.

functions.name: create_connection_request
functions.description: Create a new connectivity request on the cloud exchange, including technical parameters and commercial options.

feasibility_reference_id.description: Optional reference to a previous feasibility check result

technical_config.description: Technical configuration for the requested connection

ip_config.description: Optional L3 configuration on the source side

provider_account.description: Identifiers needed by the provider to map the connection

commercial_terms.description: Commercial options associated with this request

notifications.description: Notification preferences for this connection request

secret.description: Optional secret used to sign webhook callbacks

functions.returns: New connection_request_id with initial status, along with a summary of technical and commercial parameters.

functions.name: generate_connection_quote
functions.description: Generate a commercial quote for a given connection request, including breakdown of charges and estimated taxes.

pricing_options.description: Options influencing how pricing is calculated

regional_tax_overrides.description: Override tax rules for specific regions

functions.returns: quote_id with detailed recurring and non-recurring charges, validity period, and acceptance conditions.

functions.name: submit_connection_order
functions.description: Submit a connection request and associated quote for provisioning, creating a provisioning task and locking pricing.

activation_preferences.description: Preferences for when and how the connection should be activated

functions.returns: Provisioning task_id, current order status, and a preliminary connection_id placeholder if already reserved.

functions.name: get_provisioning_task_status
functions.description: Retrieve status and progress details for a provisioning task associated with a connection order.

page_logs.description: Pagination options for logs when included

functions.returns: Current provisioning status, percentage complete, step breakdown (if requested), and any error details if the task failed.

functions.name: get_connection_details
functions.description: Retrieve detailed technical, commercial, and operational information about an existing connection on the exchange.

include.description: Specify additional data to be returned

functions.returns: Full connection object with technical configuration, commercial data, operational state, and optional related history and monitoring snapshots.

functions.name: list_connections
functions.description: List and filter connections for a customer or project, with support for pagination and status filters.
functions.returns: Paginated list of connections matching the filters, including basic details and counts.

functions.name: monitor_connection_health
functions.description: Fetch current and recent health metrics and alarms for a given connection.

time_range.description: Time window to query metrics for

metrics.description: Which metrics to return, blank means a default set

functions.returns: Current health summary, timeseries metrics for selected window, and any active or recent alarms.

functions.name: modify_connection
functions.description: Submit a change request for an existing connection, such as bandwidth upgrade, QoS change, or routing modification.

bandwidth_mbps.description: New desired bandwidth; omit if unchanged

reason.description: Human-readable reason for the requested change

ticket_reference.description: Optional reference to an external change ticket

functions.returns: change_request_id, preliminary impact analysis, and whether additional approval steps are required.

functions.name: retry_or_rollback_provisioning
functions.description: Handle failed or partial provisioning by retrying specific steps or rolling back the connection request.

notify_contacts.description: List of contacts to notify about the recovery action

reason.description: Explanation of why recovery is triggered

functions.returns: New or updated task_id for the recovery operation, along with the recovery plan summary and current status.

functions.name: suspend_or_terminate_connection
functions.description: Suspend (temporarily disable) or terminate (permanently decommission) an existing connection, with optional scheduling and rollback options.

schedule.description: When the lifecycle action should take effect

billing_handling.description: Instructions for how billing should be handled

approval_reference.description: Reference for approval to waive penalties if applicable

functions.returns: Confirmation of requested lifecycle action with resulting status, effective time, and any billing impact summary.

functions.name: audit_connection_activity
functions.description: Retrieve an audit trail of configuration, provisioning, and lifecycle events for a specific connection or connection request.

connection_id.description: Either connection_id or connection_request_id must be provided

functions.returns: Paginated list of audit events with timestamps, actor details, event types, and before/after snapshots where applicable.

functions.name: search_customers
functions.description: Faceted search across customer records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for cloud_exchange_connectivity_provisioning.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of customer records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_customers_by_status
functions.description: List customer records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of customer records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_customer_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single customer record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A customer record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_customers
functions.description: Submit a batch of customer records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_customers
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many customer records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_customers
functions.description: Soft-archive customer records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_customers
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of customer records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_customer_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for customer lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_customer_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created customer event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_customer_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a customer including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_customer_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for cloud_exchange_connectivity_provisioning with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_customer_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a cloud_exchange_connectivity_provisioning operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.name: pause_customer_schedule
functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled cloud_exchange_connectivity_provisioning job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated schedule status and prior pause history.

functions.name: simulate_customer_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a cloud_exchange_connectivity_provisioning execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.name: preview_customer_change
functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a customer prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.name: submit_customer_for_approval
functions.description: Submit a customer for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Updated approval state, next pending step, and any triggered automations.

functions.name: escalate_customer

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Escalation record id, paged responders, and acknowledgement timer.

functions.name: add_customer_comment

functions.description: Upload an evidence file or link as an attachment to a customer with content hash and retention.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization
